versions.name: Falley Scout Reservation (Camp Jayhawk)

features.note: The Ken Staab Action Archery Range has life-size 3D animal targets on a wooded course.
Single-action .22 pistols, lever-action .22 rifles, and 20-gauge shotguns for campers fourteen and older.
Two off-camp outpost adventures, one of them an overnight.
The FSR STEAM Lab covers science, technology, engineering, art, and mathematics.

versions.summary: Traditional Scouts BSA summer camp on the 340-plus-acre Falley Scout Reservation, offering merit badges and activities in aquatics, outdoor skills, ecology, handicraft, STEAM, shooting sports, COPE, and climbing.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
